purpose: Versioned comparison target for all future governed evolution. Records the reconciled architecture, foundation implementation, verification and conformance evidence, and known gaps at the close of Gate 16 entry.
evolutionLaw: Future evolution compares against this baseline and follows OBSERVE → COMPARE → DETECT → CLASSIFY → ASSESS → PROPOSE → AUTHORIZE → IMPLEMENT → VERIFY → CONFORM → NEW BASELINE. Drift never authorizes change by itself.
